perceptualAcceptance: human-listening-required; numerical signal checks do not establish convincing force or recognition

criteria.finiteNonclippingMatrix: All nine preview WAVs must exist, contain finite PCM and have no full-scale samples.
criteria.rendererDiagnostics: All eight processed cases must report zero limiter, missing PCM history, cursor reset, rejected control and affected-history-frame counters.
criteria.loudnessAvailability: All nine previews must have successful FFmpeg EBU R128 measurements.
criteria.sourceOverlapEnergy: Every processed engine/exhaust overlapEnergyDb must be >= -3 dB: a declared review threshold retaining approximately half the selected unphased raw energy, not a universal perceptual target.
criteria.closeBodyShare: Close versus dry 20-500 Hz relative power share must be >= -6 dB. This is a diagnostic review flag, not an SPL or bass-equalization target. A failure requires investigation of retarded two-emitter interference before compensation.
criteria.recession: Near-pass RMS must exceed final-second RMS, and final-second absolute 2-6 kHz Welch energy must be lower. Source state and directivity also change; this does not isolate atmospheric absorption.
criteria.controlledComparisons: All processed cases share the declared source gain and master; seven stationary environment cases share source and motion hashes.
criteria.interpretation: Passing these numerical criteria does not establish subjective strength, recognition, physical SPL or human approval.
